ReturningToPrayer.6: Intambwe rusange zo gusubukura salat nyuma y'imihango, utuje.
ReturningToPrayer.8: Ibi bikubiyemo amakuru agamije kwigisha gusa. Ibibazo by'idini bigomba kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa ibyemezo by'idini byihariye.
ReturningToPrayer.14: Ghusl ni ukwiyuhagira kw'idini kwuzuye: ni ukwoza umubiri wose ufite umugambi wo gusubira mu isuku y'idini (tahara), ikenewe kugira ngo usenge kandi ukore ibindi bikorwa byo gusenga.
ReturningToPrayer.15: Mbere yo gukora ghusl, ni ngombwa kwemeza ko imihango yarangiye koko: ghusl igomba gukurikira, ntibe mbere y'ukwizera ko kuva amaraso kwahagaze. Muri rusange, iherezo rimenyekana iyo amaraso ahagaze burundu, ikaba yarabonywe mu gihe gihagije cyo gukuraho gushidikanya — iyi ngingo isobanurwa mu buryo burambuye mu nkuru yeguriwe isuku y'idini.
ReturningToPrayer.16: Iyi suku ni yo igufasha gusubira mu bihe byo gusenga byari byahagaritswe mu gihe cy'imihango.
ReturningToPrayer.18: Nta mpamvu yo kwihutira: ghusl ishobora gukorwa igihe cyose witeguye, nta gitutu, iyo iherezo ry'imihango ryemejwe nta gushidikanya.
ReturningToPrayer.19: Ghusl ishingiye ku mahame rusange asangiwe: umugambi wo kwiyeza, no koza umubiri wose neza, harimo umusatsi n'uruhu. Nyamara, ibisobanuro nyabyo by'uburyo bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'imyumvire ya fiqh ukurikiza.
ReturningToPrayer.21: Nta buryo na bumwe bwerekanwa hano nk'ubwonyine bwemewe: kwifashisha imyumvire cyangwa igitekerezo usanzwe ukurikiza, cyangwa gusaba inama umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi, bizagufasha kumenya ibisobanuro nyabyo bijyanye n'imimerere yawe.
ReturningToPrayer.22: Iyo imihango irangiye kandi ghusl yakozwe, salat isubukurwa nk'uko bisanzwe, nta gutinda kwihariye cyangwa indi nshingano yiyongera.
ReturningToPrayer.23: Ni byiza gutandukanya ibintu bibiri bikurikiza amategeko atandukanye: salat zidakozwe mu gihe cy'imihango muri rusange ntizisubirwamo, naho iminsi yo kwiyiriza ubusa yasibye muri Ramadan igomba gusubirwamo nyuma (qada).
ReturningToPrayer.24: Urugero, umugore wagize imihango y'iminsi 6 asubukura salat nk'uko bisanzwe nyuma ya ghusl, atiriwe asubiramo salat z'iyo minsi 6. Naho iminsi 6 yo kwiyiriza ubusa ihuye na yo izasubirwamo nyuma ya Ramadan.
ReturningToPrayer.25: Kumenya nta gushidikanya ko imihango yarangiye
ReturningToPrayer.26: Gukora ghusl (kwiyuhagira kwuzuye) kugira ngo usubire mu isuku y'idini
ReturningToPrayer.27: Gusubukura salat nk'uko bisanzwe, nta gutinda
ReturningToPrayer.28: Kumenya ko salat zasibye mu gihe cy'imihango muri rusange zidasubirwamo
ReturningToPrayer.29: Gusaba inama umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi ku mimerere yihariye cyangwa gushidikanya gukomeje

SideEffects.6: Zimwe mu ngaruka zishobora kuba zisanzwe kandi z'igihe gito. Izindi zisaba kwitabwaho cyane. Menya gutandukanya ibisanzwe n'ibimenyetso bikwiye gusuzumwa.
SideEffects.14: Iyo umuntu atangiye uburyo bushya bwo kuboneza urubyaro bukoresha hormone, umubiri ushobora gukenera igihe cyo kwimenyereza. Impinduka nto zishobora kugaragara mu mihango, mu marangamutima, cyangwa mu buzima bw'umubiri.
SideEffects.15: Izi ngaruka akenshi ziba zoroheje kandi zishobora kugenda zigabanuka buhoro buhoro. Kuba zihari ntibivuze ko uburyo bukoreshwa ari bubi cyangwa ko bugomba guhagarikwa.
SideEffects.17: Kuva amaraso bidasanzwe bishobora kubaho, cyane cyane mu ntangiriro y'uburyo bushya.
SideEffects.19: Amabere ashobora kumera nk'ayuzuye cyangwa kubabara by'igihe gito.
SideEffects.21: Bamwe babona impinduka mu marangamutima cyangwa kumva cyane ibintu.
SideEffects.23: Kubabara umutwe koroheje bishobora kubaho mu gihe cyo kwimenyereza.
SideEffects.24: Ibyumweru cyangwa imihango ya mbere bishobora gutandukana n'ibyo wari umenyereye mbere. Umubiri ushobora kwimenyereza buhoro buhoro ku buringanire bushya bwa hormone.
SideEffects.26: Ingaruka igaragaye nyuma gato yo gutangira uburyo ikwiye gukurikiranwa uko igihe gishira. Niba ibabaje cyangwa ikomeje, vugana n'umuhanga mu buzima.
SideEffects.27: Bishobora kugufasha kwandika ibimenyetso muri porogaramu kugira ngo ukurikirane neza uko bihinduka kuva ku mihango ujya ku yindi.
SideEffects.32: Reba niba cyoroha cyangwa kirushaho kuba kibi.
SideEffects.33: Ibimenyetso byose ntibifitanye isano n'uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro. Umunaniro, ibitotsi, imirire, imihango yawe, cyangwa indi miti na byo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku buryo wumva umeze.
SideEffects.34: Kugira ngo wumve imimerere, gerageza kureba ishusho rusange aho gushingira ku kimenyetso kimwe gusa.
SideEffects.35: Impinduka zikomeye kandi zihoraho mu marangamutima
SideEffects.37: Kuva amaraso bidasanzwe kumara imihango irenga 3
SideEffects.38: Iseseme cyangwa kubabara umutwe bikomeza kukubangamira
SideEffects.40: Ibi bimenyetso bimaze igihe kingana iki?
SideEffects.41: Byagaragaye nyuma yo gutangira cyangwa guhindura uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro?
SideEffects.42: Ni bworoshye, bukubangamira, cyangwa ni ibidasanzwe kuri wowe koko?
SideEffects.43: Biragenda bigabanuka uko igihe gishira cyangwa biragenda biba byinshi?
SideEffects.44: Nubwo ikimenyetso kitaba cyihutirwa, byaba byiza kukivugaho iyo kikubangamira, gikomeje, cyangwa kigira ingaruka ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi.
SideEffects.46: ibimenyetso bikomeje, birushaho gukomera, cyangwa bikubuza kubaho nk'uko bisanzwe.
SideEffects.47: Muganga, umubyaza, cyangwa umufarumasiye ashobora kugufasha kumenya niba ibimenyetso bishobora kuba bifitanye isano n'uburyo ukoresha n'niba bugomba guhindurwa.
SideEffects.48: Ibimenyetso bimwe ntibisanzwe kandi bisaba gusuzumwa n'abaganga vuba. Ntibivuze byanze bikunze ko hari ikibazo gikomeye, ariko ntibigomba kwirengagizwa.
SideEffects.50: Saba inama z'ubuvuzi vuba niba ugize by'umwihariko:
SideEffects.51: Kubabara cyane cyangwa bidasanzwe mu gituza
SideEffects.53: Kubyimba cyangwa kubabara bidasanzwe mu kuguru
SideEffects.54: Kubabara umutwe gitunguranye, gukabije, cyangwa bidasanzwe
SideEffects.55: Ibibazo bitunguranye mu kureba, mu kuvuga, cyangwa mu mbaraga
SideEffects.57: Niba ibimenyetso bije gitunguranye, ari bikomeye cyane, cyangwa biherekejwe no guhumeka bigoye, kumva ushaka guta ubwenge, cyangwa ikindi kimenyetso gikomeye, shaka ubutabazi bw'ubuvuzi bwihuse.
SideEffects.59: Ingaruka zimwe zishobora kugaragara mu ntangiriro y'uburyo bushya bwo kuboneza urubyaro bukoresha hormone.
SideEffects.60: Ingaruka nyinshi ni iz'igihe gito kandi zishobora kugabanuka uko igihe gishira.
SideEffects.61: Ikimenyetso kibangamira cyangwa gikomeje cyaba cyiza kivuzwe n'umuhanga.
SideEffects.62: Ibimenyetso bimwe bidasanzwe bisaba inama z'ubuvuzi vuba.
SideEffects.64: Kumva umubiri wawe ntibivuze byanze bikunze guhita uhagarika uburyo. Andika ibyo wumva, kurikirana uko bihinduka, kandi usabe inama igihe cyose ikimenyetso kigutera impungenge.
SideEffects.65: Iyi nkuru igamije gutanga amakuru kandi ntisimbura inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye. Niba ufite ikimenyetso gikomeye cyangwa kidasanzwe, saba inama umuhanga mu buzima.

SleepHormones.1:
Ubutotsi na hormone:
isano itazwi cyane
SleepHormones.6: Impamvu ubutotsi bwawe buhinduka bitewe n'igice cy'uruzinduko rw'imihango urimo, no mu gihe cya menopause.
SleepHormones.8: Impamvu hormone zigira ingaruka ku butotsi
SleepHormones.14: Progesterone ifite ingaruka yoroheje yo gutuza; kugabanuka kwayo ku iherezo ry'uruzinduko bishobora guhungabanya ubutotsi, bigatuma burushaho koroha cyangwa guca ku bice.
SleepHormones.16: Izamuka rito ry'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri nyuma ya ovulation rishobora no gutuma gusinzira birushaho kugorana gato kuri bamwe.
SleepHormones.18: Kutumva neza mu mubiri n'umunaniro bishobora gutuma ubutotsi burushaho koroha.
SleepHormones.20: Ubutotsi muri rusange buba buhamye cyane ku bantu benshi.
SleepHormones.22: Kugabanuka kwa progesterone bishobora gutuma ubutotsi burushaho koroha, ukaba watagaguka.
SleepHormones.23: Mu gihe cya menopause, ibyuya by'ijoro ni impamvu isanzwe yo gukanguka, kubera impamvu za hormone zisa.
SleepHormones.24: Umunaniro ushobora gukomeza guhungabana k'ubutotsi mu bice by'uruzinduko bisanzwe bifite ubushobozi bwo guhungabana. Uburyo woroshye bwo kuruhuka (guhumeka, kwirambura buhoro) bushobora kugufasha gutuza mbere yo kuryama.
SleepHormones.25: Gahunda ihamye mbere yo kuryama n'icyumba gikonje bifasha kugabanya ibi bibazo, ku myaka yose.
SleepHormones.27: Kuryama no gukanguka mu masaha ahamye bifasha kugenga isaha y'imbere mu mubiri wawe.
SleepHormones.29: Urumuri rwa bleu rushobora gutinza gusinzira; kuruhuka kuri telefoni bigufasha gutuza.
SleepHormones.31: Ubushyuhe buringaniye bworohereza gusinzira, ku myaka yose.
SleepHormones.32: Ingeso nziza ntizihora zihagije. Byaba byiza kuvugana n'umuhanga niba:
SleepHormones.35: Umunaniro urimo gukomeretsa cyane ubuzima bwa buri munsi
SleepHormones.36: Kudasinzira bikomeza nubwo ufite ingeso nziza
SleepHormones.38: Kwandika igihe ibibazo bimaze n'icyo bigaragara ko kibitera bishobora gufasha umuhanga mu buzima kukuyobora neza.
SleepHormones.40: Izi mpinduka z'ubutotsi ni zisanzwe kandi akenshi ni iz'igihe gito: ntibivuze ko hari ikibazo.
SleepHormones.41: Progesterone ifite ingaruka yoroheje yo gutuza; kugabanuka kwayo ku iherezo ry'uruzinduko bishobora guhungabanya ubutotsi.
SleepHormones.42: Mu gihe cya menopause, ibyuya by'ijoro ni impamvu isanzwe yo gukanguka.
SleepHormones.43: Gahunda ihamye mbere yo kuryama n'icyumba gikonje bifasha kugabanya ibi bibazo, ku myaka yose.
SleepHormones.44: Ibibazo by'ubutotsi bikomeje byaba byiza bivuzwe n'umuhanga mu buzima.
SleepHormones.45: Ibikubiyemo bigamije gutanga amakuru. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye. Niba ushidikanya, saba inama umuhanga mu buzima.
SleepHormones.46: Ubutotsi na hormone: isano itazwi cyane — AWA

UnderstandCycle.8: Ibice by'ingenzi by'uruzinduko rwawe, bisobanuwe mu buryo bworoshye.
UnderstandCycle.19: Buri gice gifite uruhare rw'ingenzi mu mubiri wawe kandi gishobora kugira ingaruka ku mbaraga zawe, ku marangamutima yawe no ku bimenyetso byawe.
UnderstandCycle.22: Umubiri wawe ukuramo igice cy'imbere cy'nyababyeyi.
UnderstandCycle.28: Igi rirekurwa. Ni cyo gihe cyo gusama cyane.
UnderstandCycle.31: Umubiri wawe witegura inda yaba ibayeho.
UnderstandCycle.33: Uruzinduko rwawe rushobora guhinduka kuva ku kwezi ujya ku kundi. Umunaniro, ibitotsi, imirire cyangwa uburwayi bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gihe cyarwo no ku buryo rugenda.
UnderstandCycle.40: Gukurikirana uruzinduko rwawe mu buryo bworoshye
UnderstandCycle.42: Umva umubiri wawe, ukomeze kwitegereza ibyo wumva, kandi wandike ibihinduka uko iminsi ishira.

UnderstandMenstrualFlow.1:
Gusobanukirwa imihango yawe:
ibiba bibaye koko
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.4: Imihango yawe ni igice cy'inzira karemano y'ingenzi ku buzima bwa hormone n'ubw'imyororokere. Gusobanukirwa ibiba mu mubiri wawe bishobora kugufasha kumva utuje muri buri ruzinduko.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.10: Imihango ni ukuva k'igice cy'imbere cy'nyababyeyi iyo nta gusama kwabayeho. Ibi biba rimwe mu kwezi hafi.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.12: Buri mugore arihariye: igihe, uburemere n'ibyo wumva bishobora gutandukana kuva ku ruzinduko ujya ku rundi.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.13: Amaraso ntaba amwe mu gihe cyose cy'imihango yawe. Akenshi ahinduka buri munsi, mu bwinshi, mu ibara no mu buryo ameze.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.15: Amaraso akenshi aba menshi mu minsi ya mbere.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.17: Amaraso muri rusange atangira kugabanuka buhoro buhoro.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.19: Amaraso aba make kandi ashobora gufata ibara ry'umukara.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.21: Ibi bishobora gutandukana kuva ku ruzinduko ujya ku rundi. Icy'ingenzi ni ukumenya uko usanzwe ugenda.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.22: Impinduka zimwe ni zisanzwe mu gihe cy'imihango. Ibindi bimenyetso bikwiye kwitabwaho cyane, cyane cyane iyo ari bishya cyangwa bikabije.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.28: Kuva ku mutuku utangaje kugeza ku mutuku wijimye cyangwa ikigina ku iherezo ry'imihango yawe.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.30: Ushobora kumva kuribwa mu nda koroheje kugeza ku buringaniye.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.33: Amaraso yuzuza agatambaro cyangwa tampon vuba cyane
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.34: Umunaniro ukabije, kumva ushaka guta ubwenge, cyangwa kuzungera
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.35: Impinduka itunguranye kandi ihoraho ku buryo usanzwe ugenda
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.36: Ingeso zoroshye zishobora gufasha koroshya kutumva neza no gutuma iminsi ya mbere y'imihango yawe irushaho kuba myiza.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.38:
Nywa amazi
ahagije kugira ngo
ugabanye umunaniro.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.39:
Shyira ubushyuhe
ku nda yo hasi
igihe bikenewe.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.40:
Gerageza igikorwa
cyoroheje: kugenda,
yoga, kwirambura.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.43: Kuruhuka, ubushyuhe n'ibikorwa byoroheje bishobora gufasha. Niba ububabare bukomeje kuba bukabije cyangwa budasanzwe, saba inama z'ubuvuzi.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.44: Gusobanukirwa imihango yawe: ibiba bibaye koko — AWA

VaginalRing.1:
Ring yo mu gitsina
yo kuboneza urubyaro
VaginalRing.12: Ring ni igikoresho cyoroshye gisohora buri gihe hormone nke mu gitsina, gifite ingaruka imwe yo kuboneza urubyaro nk'ibinini bivanze.
VaginalRing.20: Wowe ubwawe urayinjiza, ikaguma ahantu hayo ibyumweru bitatu bikurikiranye, hanyuma ikavanwamo mu cyumweru kimwe cyo kuruhuka kirimo imihango yawe.
VaginalRing.27: Aho ishyizwe mu gitsina nticyenewe kuba nyakuri kugira ngo ikore neza, bituma yoroha gukoresha.
VaginalRing.28: Ring ifite ingingo nyinshi z'ingirakamaro zikwiye kumenyekana mbere yo kuyihitamo.
VaginalRing.32: Muri rusange iguma ahantu hayo ibyumweru bitatu.
VaginalRing.34: Hormone zisohoka buri gihe mu gihe cyose cyo kuyikoresha.
VaginalRing.36: Uburinzi bwiyongera bushobora gukenerwa bitewe n'imimerere.
VaginalRing.38: Oga intoki mbere yo kuyinjiza cyangwa kuyikuramo
VaginalRing.39: Hitamo igihe cyoroshye kwibuka kugira ngo ukurikirane gahunda
VaginalRing.40: Rimwe na rimwe reba ko ikiri ahantu hayo
VaginalRing.41: Reba agatabo kayo niba yimutse cyangwa yasohotse
VaginalRing.43: Gusohoka cyangwa kwimuka igihe kirekire bishobora gusaba ubuyobozi bwihariye. Buri gihe reba agatabo k'igikoresho cyangwa ubaze umuhanga mu buzima niba ushidikanya.
VaginalRing.46: Ring ushobora kuyinjiza ukayikuramo wowe ubwawe.
VaginalRing.48: Muri rusange ikurikiza uruzinduko rw'ibyumweru bitatu n'icyumweru kimwe cyo kuruhuka.
VaginalRing.50: Kugenzura buri gihe ko iri ahantu hayo bigufasha gukoresha igikoresho utuje.
VaginalRing.51: Nta burinzi bw'indwara zandurira mu mibonano
VaginalRing.52: Uburinzi bukwiye bushobora gukenerwa bitewe n'imimerere.
VaginalRing.54: Ring yo mu gitsina ihuza gusohora hormone buri gihe na gahunda yo kuyikoresha yirinda kunywa ikinini buri munsi. Icyakora, guhitamo uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bigomba kuba bihuye na buri muntu kandi bikaganirwaho n'umuhanga mu buzima.
VaginalRing.55: Ring yo mu gitsina yo kuboneza urubyaro — AWA

week1.0: Inda ibarwa uhereye ku munsi wa mbere w'imihango yawe iheruka, ku bw'amategero y'ubuvuzi. Muri iki gihe, muri rusange gusama kuba kutaraba.
week1.1: Iki gihe muri rusange kiza mbere yo gusama; akenshi nta mpinduka y'umubiri ijyanye n'inda iba ihari.
week1.2: Kubara inda uhereye ku mihango iheruka bitanga uburyo busanzwe bwo kugereranya itariki yo kubyara, nubwo gusama kuba hashize igihe gito.
week1.3: Ni ibisanzwe kutabona impinduka iyo ari yo yose muri iki gihe.

week2.0: Ovulation no gusama gushoboka muri rusange biba hafi muri iki gihe, bitewe n'uburebure bw'uruzinduko rwa buri muntu.
week2.1: Igihe cya ovulation gishobora gutandukana bitewe n'uburebure bw'uruzinduko, bigira ingaruka ku itariki nyayo gusama gushobora kubaho.
week2.2: Muri rusange nta mpinduka y'umubiri yihariye y'inda iba ihari muri iki gihe.
week2.3: Igihe nyacyo cya ovulation gitandukana ku muntu n'undi, ni yo mpamvu iki gihe gikomeza kuba igereranya.

week3.0: Niba gusama kwabayeho, igi ritangira kwigabanyamo no kwerekeza mu nyababyeyi, ariko nta kintu gishobora kuboneka n'ikizamini cy'inda.
week3.1: Iki cyumweru kiracyari mu gihe cyo kubara mu buvuzi gikikije gusama; nta kimenyetso cy'umubiri kigaragara muri rusange muri iki gihe.
week3.2: Ibizamini byinshi by'inda bikoreshwa mu nkari bigira icyizere guhera mu cyumweru gikurikira, igihe kwiyomekaho kwatangiye.

week4.0: Insoro yiyomekaho ku rukuta rw'inyababyeyi. Agapfunyika k'amazi n'agapfunyika k'umuhondo, kazayigaburira mu minsi ya mbere cyane, birimo kuremwa.
week4.3: Bamwe ntibabona ikimenyetso na kimwe muri iki gihe cya mbere cyane.
week4.4: Ikizamini cy'inda mu nkari muri rusange gishobora kubona inda guhera muri iki cyumweru.
week4.5: Iki ni igihe gisanzwe ikizamini cy'inda gishobora gutangira kwerekana igisubizo cyiza.

week5.0: Imiyoboro y'imyakura itangira kuremwa, kandi umutima, ukiri muto cyane, ugiye gutera ku nshuro ya mbere.
week5.3: Umunaniro udasanzwe, iseseme yoroheje, cyangwa kubabara amabere bishobora kugaragara.
week5.4: Iki ni igihe cyiza cyo gufata gahunda n'umuhanga mu buzima kugira ngo utangire gukurikiranwa mu gihe cy'inda.

week6.0: Utubuto tw'amaboko n'amaguru turagaragara, hamwe n'utuntu duto aho amatwi azaremwa. Umutima rimwe na rimwe ushobora kuboneka kuri ultrasound.
week6.3: Iseseme n'umunaniro bishobora gukomera ku bantu bamwe muri iki gihe.
week6.4: Umutima ushobora rimwe na rimwe kuboneka guhera muri iki cyumweru kuri ultrasound ya kare.

week7.0: Ubwonko bukura vuba kurusha ibindi bice by'umubiri, bigatuma uruhanga rugaragara. Utubuto duto tw'intoki dutangira kugaragara ku mpera z'amaboko.
week7.3: Kwifuza ibiryo bimwe na bimwe, cyangwa ku rundi ruhande kutabyifuza, birashoboka.
week7.4: Umuyoboro w'imyakura, utanga ubwonko n'umugongo, ukomeza gufunga muri ibi byumweru.

week8.0: Insoro ubu yitwa umwana uri mu nda. Amaboko ariyongera, umutwe utangira kugororoka gato, kandi urugingo rutanga amaraso ku mwana (placenta) rukomeza kuremwa.
week8.3: Kumva cyane impumuro n'iseseme yo mu gitondo ni ibisanzwe muri iki gihe, nubwo atari kuri bose.
week8.4: Ultrasound ya mbere yo kugena itariki isanzwe iteganywa hagati y'icyumweru cya 8 n'icya 14.

week9.0: Isura irushaho kugaragara neza, ibirenge by'amaso birinda amaso, kandi amaboko n'ibirenge biri gufata ishusho hamwe n'intoki zizaza.
week9.3: Umunaniro ukabije n'iseseme bishobora kuba bigihari; akenshi bigenda bigabanuka ku iherezo ry'igihembwe cya mbere.
week9.4: Ibice by'imyanya ndangagitsina bitangiye gutandukana, ariko igitsina muri rusange ntikimenyekana kugeza nyuma cyane, kuri ultrasound y'imiterere.

week10.0: Isura irushaho kumenyekana, ibirenge by'amaso bikora ku rumuri, kandi umutima utera vuba, hafi inshuro eshatu kurusha uw'umuntu mukuru.
week10.3: Mu rukenyerero rwawe hashobora gutangira guhinduka gato, nubwo inda muri rusange itaragaragara.
week10.4: Isuzuma rihuriweho ry'igihembwe cya mbere, iyo rihawe, muri rusange rikorwa hagati y'icyumweru cya 11 n'icya 14.

week11.0: Intoki z'amaboko n'iz'ibirenge ziratandukana, inzara nto zirakura, kandi placenta igenda isimbura agapfunyika k'umuhondo mu kugaburira umwana.
week11.3: Ushobora kubona guhindagurika kw'amarangamutima, bifitanye isano by'umwihariko n'impinduka za hormone.
week11.4: Ingendo z'umwana zirimo gutangira, ariko muri rusange ntiziragaragara muri iki gihe.

week12.0: Ingingo z'imbere n'imikaya byakuze neza, kandi amagufwa atangiye gukomera. Ingingo z'imyororokere zarakozwe, nubwo zitaragaragara kuri ultrasound.
week12.3: Iseseme akenshi igenda igabanuka buhoro buhoro hafi muri iki gihe, nubwo bitandukanye cyane ku muntu n'undi.
week12.4: Iherezo ry'igihembwe cya mbere akenshi rifitanye isano n'ibyago bike byo gukuramo inda ugereranyije n'ibyumweru byabanje.

week13.0: Ingendo, zikiri zo gukubita, zirushaho guhuzwa gato. Bamwe mu bana basanzwe bafite ingeso yo konka igikumwe.
week13.3: Abantu benshi basubirana imbaraga nke buhoro buhoro uko igihembwe cya kabiri kigenda kiza.
week13.4: Igihembwe cya mbere muri rusange kirangira hafi muri iki cyumweru; gukurikiranwa kuracyakomeza hamwe n'inama zitaba kenshi.

week14.0: Umutwe urushaho kuba uruziga kandi ukangana n'ibindi bice by'umubiri. Umwana aconga amazi make y'inda, anyura mu gifu no mu mpyiko.
week14.3: Inda itangira kugaragara neza ku bantu bamwe.
week14.4: Umuhanga mu buzima rimwe na rimwe ashobora gutangira kumva umutima ukoresheje igikoresho cya ultrasound gishyizwe ku nda.

week15.0: Ubwoya bworoshye bwitwa lanugo buhoro buhoro bupfuka uruhu, kandi ibitsike n'ibyiyi by'amaso bitangira kugaragara. Amaso arumva urumuri.
week15.3: Ubushake bwo kurya bwawe bushobora guhinduka, rimwe na rimwe hakabaho kwifuza cyangwa kwanga ibiryo bishya.
week15.4: Kumva bitangira gukura hafi muri iki gihe: ijwi ryawe n'amajwi y'imbere mu mubiri buhoro buhoro bitangira kumvikana.

week16.0: Imiyoboro y'imyakura ituma amaboko n'amaguru bigenda. Amaboko ashobora gufunga nk'amadukira mato.
week16.3: Bamwe batangira kumva ingendo zoroheje cyane guhera hafi muri iki gihe, akenshi zisobanurwa nk'ukunyeganyega.
week16.4: Kumva ingendo za mbere bitandukana cyane ku nda imwe n'indi, cyane cyane bitewe n'uko ari inda ya mbere cyangwa atari yo.

week17.0: Amaso, akiri afunze, ashobora kugenda, kandi umwana ubu yumva amajwi akomeye. Imiterere y'ibirenge by'intoki iratangira kuremwa.
week17.3: Kubabara umugongo koroheje bishobora kugaragara uko aho umubiri wawe uringaniza hahinduka.
week17.4: Amajwi yo hanze atangira kumvikana, mu buryo bwumvikana buhoro, anyuze mu mazi y'inda.

week18.0: Kumva, gukora ku kintu, kumira, n'ingeso yo konka bikomeza gukura. Umwana arushaho gukora cyane, afite ingendo nyinshi z'amaboko n'amaguru.
week18.3: Inda akenshi iba igaragara neza muri iki gihe, kandi aho umubiri wawe uringaniza hakomeza guhinduka.
week18.4: Ultrasound y'imiterere, isuzuma ikura rusange ry'umwana, muri rusange itangwa hagati y'icyumweru cya 18 n'icya 21.

week19.0: Amenyo y'iteka azaza atangira kuremwa inyuma y'amenyo y'ibere ategurwa, kandi umwana akomeza kongera ibiro buhoro buhoro.
week19.3: Kumva gukururwa ku mpande z'inda (ububabare bw'imikaya ikikije nyababyeyi) bishobora kubaho uko nyababyeyi ikura.
week19.4: Iki ni igihe gisanzwe cyo gutangira kumva ingendo z'umwana neza kurushaho.

week20.0: Guhera muri iki cyumweru, uburebure bupimwa uhereye ku mutwe ukageza ku gatsinsino aho kuba ku mutwe ukageza ku kibuno, kuko amaguru ubu ashobora kurambuka agapimwa — ibi busobanura isimbuka rigaragara mu bunini bwo kugereranya ugereranyije n'ibyumweru byabanje.
week20.3: Inda yawe izengurutse neza ishobora gutangira kugira ingaruka ku buringanire no ku buryo uhagaze.
week20.4: Hagati y'inda akenshi hagaragazwa n'isuzuma ryuzuye ku muhanga mu buzima ugukurikirana.

week21.0: Ingendo zirushaho kuba zisobanutse kandi zihuzwa, kandi ni ibisanzwe gutangira kuzumva neza muri iki gihe.
week21.3: Guhumeka bigoye gato igihe ukoze imbaraga bishobora kugaragara uko nyababyeyi ifata umwanya munini.
week21.4: Kumenyera uko ingendo z'umwana wawe zisanzwe bituma byoroha kubona impinduka idasanzwe.

week22.0: Ibihaha bikomeza gukura, kandi umwana yimenyereza ingendo nto zo guhumeka. Imitsi yo kumva uburyohe na yo iri kuremwa.
week22.3: Kuribwa mu maguru, cyane cyane nijoro, birashoboka ku bantu bamwe.
week22.4: Ibyo urya bishobora kugira ingaruka ku mazi y'inda, umwana amira buri gihe.

week23.0: Ingingo ubu zingana neza. Umwana yimenyereza guhumeka kandi atangira guhinduranya ibihe byo gusinzira n'ibyo gukanguka.
week23.3: Kubabara umugongo cyane bishobora kugaragara uko ibiro byiyongera buhoro buhoro.
week23.4: Kwitegereza ibihe umwana akora n'ibihe aruhuka bigufasha kumenya uko yihariye.

week24.0: Umwana agera ku rugero rwo kubaho: mu gihe cyo kubyara hakiri kare cyane muri iki gihe, ubuvuzi bwihariye bw'abana bavutse bushobora gutuma abaho, hamwe n'ubufasha bukwiye.
week24.3: Igitutu cyiyongereye ku ruhago no kumva ushaka kujya kunyara kenshi bishobora kugaragara.
week24.4: Isuzuma ry'diyabete y'inda muri rusange ritangwa hafi muri iki gihe.

week25.0: Umwana ubu agira icyo akora ku majwi akomeye, ahinda umushyitsi cyangwa agakubita ikirenge, kandi ushobora rimwe na rimwe kumva ahangayutse (hiccups). Anyara buri gihe mu mazi y'inda.
week25.3: Ikirungurira cyangwa gusubiza ibyo wariye bishobora kuba byinshi.
week25.4: Hiccups z'umwana zumvikana rimwe na rimwe muri rusange zifatwa nk'ibisanzwe.

week26.0: Amaso arakingura ku nshuro ya mbere. Ibara ryayo ryanyuma muri rusange ntirizamenyekana kugeza amezi menshi nyuma yo kuvuka.
week26.3: Kubyimba koroheje kw'amaguru cyangwa ibirenge bishobora kugaragara, cyane cyane ku iherezo ry'umunsi.
week26.4: Igihembwe cya gatatu kiregereje, gukurikiranwa n'abaganga muri rusange birushaho kuba kenshi.

week27.0: Ibihaha bigira ubushobozi bwo gutangira guhumeka, kandi umwana akomeza kubyibuha uko ibinure bibitswe munsi y'uruhu.
week27.3: Umunaniro ushobora gusubira uko umubiri wawe wikorera ibiro byiyongera.
week27.4: Intangiriro y'igihembwe cya gatatu akenshi ni igihe cyiza cyo gutangira gutekereza ku mugambi wawe wo kubyara.

week28.0: Umutima, watera vuba cyane mu ntangiriro y'inda, ubu wahamye hafi inshuro 130 kugeza kuri 140 mu munota kandi ushobora kumvikana na stethoscope.
week28.3: Guhumeka bigoye cyangwa ikirungurira bishobora kuba byinshi uko nyababyeyi ifata umwanya munini.
week28.4: Igihembwe cya gatatu muri rusange gitangira hafi muri iki cyumweru, hamwe n'inama zirushaho kuba nyinshi.

week29.0: Umwana yamaze kuremwa neza; ibyumweru biri imbere bizaba ahanini ibyo gukura kw'ingingo no kongera ibiro. Agahu koroheje kakingira uruhu rwe gatangira kongera gufatwa n'umubiri.
week29.3: Gusinzira bishobora kuba bigoye kubera inda yawe ikura.
week29.4: Kuruhukira ku ruhande rw'ibumoso akenshi birasabwa mu gihe cy'inda igeze kure kugira ngo bifashe imigendekere y'amaraso.

week30.0: Kureba bikomeza gukura; ku mavuko, umwana azashobora kubona isura zegereye, mbere yo kwiga buhoro buhoro gukurikira ibintu bigenda.
week30.3: Kumva uburemere mu mugongo wo hasi cyangwa mu rukenyerero bishobora kwiyongera.
week30.4: Inama zo mbere yo kubyara muri rusange zirushaho kuba nyinshi guhera muri iki gihe.

week31.0: Umwana agenda cyane, rimwe na rimwe yonka intoki, kandi ashobora gukora ingendo nini. Uruhu rwe rugabanya iminkanyari uko ibinure bigenda byiyongera.
week31.3: Kwiyegeranya kw'umubiri kwo kwitoza, kwitwa Braxton Hicks, gushobora gutangira kumvikana rimwe na rimwe.
week31.4: Umwana atangira kumenya amajwi amwe yamenyerewe yumva buri gihe aturutse hanze.

week32.0: Umwana yamaze kuremwa neza kandi buhoro buhoro ari kwicara umutwe ugana hasi yitegura kuvuka. Ahanini akomeza kongera ibiro mu byumweru bisigaye.
week32.3: Kongera ibiro cyane birasanzwe muri iki gihe, bifitanye isano no gukura k'umwana.
week32.4: Gushyira umutwe hasi (cephalic presentation) birushaho kuba bisanzwe uko igihe cyo kubyara kigenda kigera.

week33.0: Ubwonko n'imiyoboro y'imyakura ubu byakuze neza. Amagufwa akomeza gukomera, uretse ay'igihanga, akomeza kuba yoroshye kugira ngo byorohereze kunyura igihe cyo kubyara.
week33.3: Kugorwa no kubona uburyo bwiza bwo gusinzira birasanzwe muri iki gihe.
week33.4: Koroha kw'amagufwa y'igihanga igihe cyo kuvuka ni iby'igihe gito kandi buhoro buhoro arafunga mu mwaka wa mbere.
